dependencies.$comment: alsa is not one of SDL2's default features, so Linux builds shipped with no ALSA backend compiled in and SDL fell back to its OSS driver -- a bug report from an Arch/PipeWire desktop logged 'SDL driver: dsp'. The vcpkg alsa port builds alsa-lib from source (only autoconf/libtool from the system, which CI already installs), and SDL dlopens libasound.so.2 at runtime, so this also covers pipewire-alsa and pulseaudio's ALSA shim. pipewire and pulseaudio are not features this port exposes.
dependencies.name: sdl2

dependencies.$comment: Target-side bgfx: the renderer library only. The shader/texture/geometry compilers come from the host-side entry below so cross builds (riscv64-linux, arm64-windows, x64-osx on an arm64 runner) get tools that run on the build machine; when host and target triplets coincide vcpkg merges both entries into one bgfx[core,tools] install and nothing changes.
dependencies.name: bgfx
